questions.stem: In the dispatcher's log, 'elle se lave' is noted; what does se indicate here?

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: se rendre compte, where the pronoun is a plain subject
questions.learningObjective: Evaluate fixed pronoun in context
questions.stem: In the dispatcher's log, a planner groups 'il se rend compte', 'elle se lave', 'ils se battent' by pronoun type; which grouping is right?

options.text: All three use se as a fixed pronoun
se rend compte reflexive, se lave passive, se battent fixed
All three are reflexive
se rend compte fixed, se lave reflexive, se battent reciprocal

questions.explanation: The three verbs cover fixed pronoun, reflexive and reciprocal uses. The errors are to collapse them or scramble them.
questions.hint: Check whether se names a second person.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: The reflexive use of a pronominal verb
questions.learningObjective: Apply reflexive use in a stimulus

stimulus.body: A train dispatcher writes 'elle se lave' on the log and asks the team to state whether the subject acts on itself. The team must note that se points back to the subject. Original content only.

questions.stem: In the dispatcher's log, what does 'se lave' mean?

options.text: An impersonal construction
A second person receives the action
A passive meaning with no agent
The subject acts on itself

questions.explanation: 'se lave' means the subject acts on itself. The errors are to treat it as transitive or passive.
questions.hint: Se points back to the subject.

questions.stem: In the dispatcher's log, what does 'se ferme' express?

options.text: Someone closing the door for another
options.misconception: reads an agent into the construction

options.text: A passive with an unnamed agent
The door acting on itself with no second person
A reciprocal action between two doors

questions.hint: No one else is involved.
